methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-18: perk.com/pricing, itilite.com/pricing, routespring.com/pricing, navan.com/pricing, travelbank.com/travel-pricing-package, travelbank.com/all-in-one-pricing-package. The TravelPerk->Perk rebrand (Nov 2025) is confirmed; perk.com/pricing is live and lists Starter $0 / Premium $99 / Pro $299 with 5%/3%/3% per-booking fees (NA travel-only plans). Egencia is now branded 'Amex GBT Egencia'; both egencia.com/en/business-travel-pricing and the Amex GBT pricing/Egencia pages were blocked (HTTP 403), and all aggregator + vendor sources confirm a quote-only, sales-led model with no published numeric pricing — monthlyUsd left null. Spotnana's /pricing page is confirmed HTTP 404; platform + security pages confirm a quote-only model. TravelBank travel-only plans are flat ANNUAL fees ($5,000 and $10,000/year); monthlyUsd is populated with the monthly-equivalent ($416.67 and $833.33) and the annual flat-fee nature is noted. Compliance set true ONLY where the vendor explicitly states a first-party certification on an accessible page: Perk soc2 downgraded to null (security page only says policies are 'aligned with' SOC 2 / ISO 27001 and the explicit certs belong to its AWS data center — no explicit first-party SOC 2 certification claim verifiable); Routespring and Navan gdpr downgraded to null (GDPR appears only as a page-title/badge, not an explicit compliance statement). Per-booking/per-trip fees are placed in plan notes; overagePerMin/overagePerCall are telephony fields and left null. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Perk (formerly TravelPerk)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-verified on perk.com/pricing (2026-06-18): Starter $0, Premium $99, Pro $299 — all NA travel-only plans with 5%/3%/3% per-booking fees (min $2, max $30). TravelPerk->Perk rebrand confirmed (Nov 2025). soc2 set to null: perk.com/security only states policies are 'aligned with' SOC 2/ISO 27001 and lists certs for its AWS data center, with no explicit first-party SOC 2 certification claim on the accessible page.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: No monthly platform fee (NA travel-only plan). 5% per-booking fee (min $2, max $30 per booking). 1 travel policy/approval process, simplified reporting, cost objects, access to global inventory, travel alerts, events access. Fee applies from first booking (no free-booking allowance).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $99/mo (NA travel-only plan). 3% per-booking fee (min $2, max $30). Up to 10 travel policies/approvals, advanced reporting, budget tracking (up to 5), SSO, HR integrations, events access, dedicated account manager. Separately, a Europe-only Travel + Spend combo plan starts at $11/user/month (different SKU).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $299/mo (NA travel-only plan). 3% per-booking fee (min $2, max $30). Unlimited policies/approvals, custom reporting, unlimited budget tracking, SSO, advanced HR integrations, custom integrations, events access. Separately, a Europe-only Travel + Spend combo plan starts at $13/user/month (different SKU).

limits: Starter: 1 travel policy only
Premium: max 10 travel policies, 5 budget-tracking cost centers
Per-booking fee applies to all plans (5% Starter, 3% Premium/Pro)
$11/$13 Travel+Spend combo pricing is Europe-only, not the NA travel-only SKU
keyFeatures: Per-booking-fee model with a forever-free Starter tier
VAT recovery on European travel
FlexiPerk flexible cancellation add-on
Open integration ecosystem
bestFor: SMBs wanting zero upfront cost
European companies needing VAT recovery
Teams that book infrequently (Starter)

GDPR/HIPAA not explicitly stated.

plans.name: Elite (Travel)
